_doc: Sailplane tuning (Lakeside theme), loaded over config/flight.json for courses whose vehicle is "sailplane"; a key left out keeps the flight.json value, and the rest default in js/glide.js and js/sailplane.js. FLIGHT_MODEL "sail": no engine; it glides, zooms up on its speed, and climbs in thermals (course.thermals). The lift/drag shape is set by LEVEL_SPEED (slowest speed that holds level flight), TRIM_SPEED (speed of its best glide) and GLIDE_RATIO; TUCK_* is the Dive shape (Boost: flaps up), a higher trim speed and a better glide when fast, whose stick centre asks for TUCK_PATH rad of dive. Stick up climbs at up to CLIMB_MAX rad, paid for with speed (GAMMA_RATE: how fast it pulls up); run out and it stalls below STALL_SPEED (warning from STALL_WARN, flying again STALL_RECOVER m/s faster; the other stall keys default in js/sailplane.js). Mouse aim only climbs on speed to spare, so it doesn't stall. Down dives to DIVE_MAX (TUCK_DIVE_MAX in Dive). TRIM_K makes stick centre settle back to the trim speed. GLIDE_TURN scales the turn rate over a true coordinated turn, GLIDE_ROLL_RATE is the roll rate (rad/s), TOUCH_BANK/MAX_BANK the steepest bank for touch/mouse. THERMAL_CORE is the share of a thermal's radius that rises at full strength and THERMAL_FADE how far below its top the lift fades out (m); THERMAL_INFLOW is how fast the air flows in toward a thermal's core at its edge (m/s), which centres a circle flown off-centre. CRUISE is the start speed, RESPAWN_SPEED the speed back at the last hoop after a crash; BOOST only scales the speed effects.
